doc.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Family and boyhood in Concord and Ione
title: Musical ear on father's side and ethnic background
summary: His father whistled classical music by ear; Gioia asks about German, Polish and other ancestry and old-country customs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: On your father’s side of the family, were there any musicians? I know your mother was a skilled pianist, but on your father’s side, was there much musical talent?

I think there had to be, because my dad was quite musical, just what he’d be singing and whistling. You had to have a certain ear. He whistled a lot of classical music, because that’s all he got to hear.
Let me ask you about your ancestry, which seems to be a mix of German, Polish, Russian, English, maybe native American as well. Were there any ethnic customs or food
or anything like that in your early upbringing? Or did you have a very American childhood? Were there any old-country traditions or customs to your childhood?
